changelog:
Initial release: Alibaba Cloud PTS (Performance Testing Service) scenario management skill.

- Enables creation and management of stress testing scenarios via Alibaba Cloud PTS.
- Supports both PTS native HTTP/HTTPS and JMeter-based stress testing.
- Enforces confirmation of all user-customizable parameters before running any operations.
- Details required permissions and provides pre-checks for Aliyun CLI setup.
- Documents idempotency practices to prevent duplicate scenarios or tests.
- Outlines core workflows for creating, running, and managing PTS and JMeter scenarios.
